start.prompt:
Edit the FIRST supplied image (busy harbor start keyframe). SECOND supplied image is ONLY the approved calm pixel-art STYLE reference. Produce one revised widescreen 16:9 starting frame, same barge viewpoint and same protagonist strictly from behind.

Two REQUIRED corrections:
1) Repaint the entire image with the SECOND image's quiet, larger coherent pixel clusters, simpler broad shapes and calm horizontal water reflections. Remove the first image's granular sparkling microtexture, scattered tiny bright dots, roof speckling, stippled clouds and restless checkerboard wavelets. Use mostly solid connected color masses with modest stepped shading. Substantially simplify roof tiles, wood grain, garment folds and rigging. Keep recognizable pixel art, not blurred or smoothed photorealism. The water should be broad muted blue-grey horizontal bands with just a FEW elongated gold reflection strokes, just as restrained as the SECOND reference. Sky uses large soft-edged stepped cloud masses, no mottled noise.
2) REBUILD the city geography as a FLAT coastal town. The waterfront and all building foundations are at the SAME ground elevation. Buildings run horizontally along the waterfront and extend back on flat land. Camera is at HUMAN EYE LEVEL aboard the barge. A coherent near row of low warehouses and two- or three-storey townhouses largely hides buildings behind it; only an occasional small roof or chimney peeks above. Skyline stays a LOW irregular horizontal band. NO hillside, NO terraces, NO pyramidal skyline, NO towers of houses behind houses, NO uphill perspective, NO stacked rows ascending into the sky. No forest, wooded slope or mountain backdrop. Plain pale dawn sky appears above the roofs. The town is large because the waterfront extends left and right and there are many adjacent buildings, not because houses climb a hill. Remove the large church-like tower from the first image.

PRESERVE the intended lively urban port: 5-6 nearby moored merchant vessels to the left/center, some small working boats, readable simplified hulls and masts; busy landing to the right with around 8-10 separated small people carrying cargo or standing by barrels, a handcart and open warehouse. Keep these readable rather than increasing their detail. The small distant lighthouse on the far left may remain. Warm windows are restrained broad light shapes.
Keep the male traveler, his shoulder bag on left hip, clothing, full back view, approximate left-foreground position, calm stance; camera onboard, deck below him, low boat rail in foreground, clear water gap to the nearby right quay. Preserve his shape but simplify his pixel shading to the SECOND image. Boat is still approaching, man stays aboard.
Cool muted blue-grey and warm ochre dawn palette, soft thin haze along water, ordinary calm working life, not a rural village or fantasy megacity. Make the whole frame restful at a glance while keeping a lively subject.
No text, lettering, logos, border, UI or collage. Do not bring the second image's forest, hills or sparse settlement into this new scene.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: the START keyframe of a restrained cinematic opening for a narrative pixel-art game, landscape widescreen 16:9, preferably 1536x864 or another exact 16:9 size. Produce ONE image, not a storyboard.
Reference image role: ONLY the visual medium, pixel cluster scale, restrained rendering and color sensibility of the supplied pixel town image. Invent a completely new harbor composition; do not copy that street or the game's existing pier.
Scene: early autumn dawn in a grounded fictional medieval coastal town with no magic. View from INSIDE a modest low wooden cargo barge as it approaches a small working landing. Camera aboard at human chest height behind the passenger, facing forward slightly toward the right bank. Broad water occupies the center. At the RIGHT midground a short low wooden landing projects toward the water, with 4 clearly separated mooring piles, a timber warehouse with a wide open doorway and a tiled roof, a few barrels and a stack of modest crates. Behind it, uneven rows of small plaster-and-timber houses step uphill, with one ordinary squat stone watchtower far away. The LEFT distance opens to harbor water, a couple of small moored boats and faint low coastal hills. This is an ordinary living port, not a fantasy megacity, pirate base or ruined world.
Subject: adult male traveler Odvin, on the LEFT foreground at approximately x=27%, seen strictly from the back, full head to lower legs, facing the landing. Modest naturally proportioned working man, short brown hair seen only from behind, plain muted brown-grey wool tunic, dark trousers and simple worn boots. A single weathered brown canvas shoulder bag hangs at his RIGHT hip with its strap crossing from his LEFT shoulder. His right hand rests lightly near the bag strap, left arm relaxed. No visible face, no armor or weapon, no heroic cape. This is a visual proposal, not a detailed facial portrait.
Foreground: the barge's simple wooden planked deck along the lower part of the frame, low gunwales defining its sides, one small coil of rope to the lower right. The passenger is clearly ON the barge, not standing on the quay. The landing remains about 5-7 meters ahead and to the right, with a visible strip of water between boat and landing; the barge has not docked yet. Leave the boat's bow direction and pier spatial layout legible.
Visual medium: genuine crafted narrative-game pixel art, clear chunky square pixel clusters, economical broad shapes, crisp stepped silhouettes, moderately low detail, controlled dithering only where necessary. Not voxel blocks, not realistic 3D, not a realistic painting with a pixel filter. Approximate detail density of a 480x270 scene enlarged cleanly. Maintain expressive composition and readable depth, no busy pixel noise or excessive microtexture.
Lighting: soft cool blue-grey morning sky and water; thin translucent low mist between boat and houses, warm pale gold dawn emerging behind clouds, just two or three small warm window lights. Enough light to read the man's clothing and wooden deck, quiet hopeful homecoming, calm everyday life.
Two tiny dockworkers in the distance, one by the open warehouse and one nearer the landing. Keep them small and simple for video continuity. Water has restrained horizontal pixel reflections.
Constraints: no lettering, logos, UI, borders or title. No collage. No giant sailing ship or forest of masts in foreground, no modern equipment, no surreal atmospheric effects. Avoid black silhouette protagonist: show simple readable clothing folds in pixel clusters. Composition must later allow the SAME camera aboard the SAME boat to move a short distance closer to the SAME landing.
